meta.name: news-aggregator
meta.description: 国内外社会、科技、军事新闻汇总。自动搜索、筛选、整理新闻要点。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动搜索并汇总国内外新闻要点
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果每天需要快速了解国内外大事
copy.tagline_en: Automatically search and summarize news highlights
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly catch up on global news daily

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会自动搜索国内外社会、科技、军事新闻，筛选可靠来源，整理成带标题、来源、要点的结构化汇总。
howto.when: 当你要求获取最新新闻或特定领域（科技、军事）的新闻汇总时触发。

say.text: 今天有哪些重要的科技新闻？
say.note: Claude 会搜索并整理科技类新闻。
Claude 会搜索并整理军事类新闻。

say.text: 汇总一下今天的社会新闻。
say.note: Claude 会搜索并整理社会类新闻。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will automatically search for domestic and international news in society, technology, and military, filter reliable sources, and organize them into a structured summary with titles, sources, and key points.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for the latest news or a summary of news in specific areas (technology, military).

say_en.text: What are the important tech news today?
say_en.note: Claude will search and organize tech news.
Claude will search and organize military news.
Claude will search and organize social news.
